CustomField.label: Bands JSON
CustomField.description: This offering's readiness tier bands, as a JSON array [{"tier":"...","lowest":N,"highest":N}, ...], ascending and contiguous. Replaces GtmAssessmentScoring.bands(), which stays as the fallback when no frame record exists or when this JSON is unusable - a malformed value falls back rather than throwing, the same fail-open discipline GtmAssessmentInstrument.resolve uses. Logically required (an offering with a frame record must declare its bands), but the platform forbids <required> on a LongTextArea, so the Apex fail-open path in GtmAssessmentScoring enforces it instead.
